name: TREEWIDTH3_LIST_COLORING_POLYNOMIAL_TERMINAL

external_authority.reference: Klaus Jansen and Petra Scheffler, Generalized coloring for tree-like graphs, Discrete Applied Mathematics 75(2):135-155 (1997)
external_authority.result: List Coloring on partial k-trees is linear-time for a fixed number of colors and polynomial-time for unbounded color sets.

external_authority.reference: Hans L. Bodlaender, A Linear-Time Algorithm for Finding Tree-Decompositions of Small Treewidth, SIAM J. Comput. 25(6):1305-1317 (1996)
external_authority.result: For every fixed k, treewidth<=k can be recognized and a width-k tree decomposition constructed in linear time.

external_authority.reference: Stefan Arnborg, Andrzej Proskurowski, Derek G. Corneil, Forbidden minors characterization of partial 3-trees, Discrete Mathematics 80(1):1-19 (1990)
external_authority.result: Graphs of treewidth at most 3 / partial 3-trees are exactly the graphs excluding four minimal forbidden minors: K5, the octahedral graph, the Wagner graph V8, and the pentagonal prism.

terminal_definition.input: A residual graph C with exact lists L(v) subseteq [4].
terminal_definition.recognition: Run fixed-k treewidth recognition for k=3. If tw(C)<=3, produce a width-3 tree decomposition.
list_DP: At each bag, retain proper assignments of colors in [4] to bag vertices that respect each exact list and extend to the processed part of the decomposition.
Introduce/forget/join transitions are exact and local.
Accept iff some root-bag state survives.
Store predecessor witnesses to reconstruct a full list-coloring.
terminal_definition.positive_certificate: A width-3 tree decomposition; verifier checks vertex coverage, edge coverage, running intersection, and bag size<=4.
terminal_definition.negative_certificate_interface: If tw(C)>3, a proof-carrying obstruction may be given as a minor model of one of the four forbidden minors {K5, OCTAHEDRON, WAGNER_V8, PENTAGONAL_PRISM}.

target_claims: For the fixed four-color palette, arbitrary-list coloring on treewidth<=3 graphs is polynomial-time solvable; with a width-3 decomposition the raw bag state space is at most 4^4=256.
Treewidth<=3 is graph-discoverable in polynomial time (indeed linear time for fixed k=3).
The terminal does not require P7-freeness for correctness.
All fixed-boundary restrictions must be encoded in exact lists before invoking the terminal.
The four listed minor obstructions are complete for treewidth<=3.

current_W2_control.conclusion: The sealed authoritative W2 K4 residual is TW3_LIST_READY.

forbidden: Infer anything about tw>3 residuals beyond non-applicability of this terminal.
Treat failure of a heuristic decomposition search as a tw>3 certificate.
Modify C11 state, Pi semantics, or start a repair.
